about: The cephlow tests that H5's portedTestsPass check requires, fixed before any of them was re-homed. Each title must appear, exactly once, among the passing tests of a test file in this repo. 'ported' keeps the original title and its behavioural assertion on stub identity, the real local D1 and the fake gateway. 'rewritten' is a new test that carries the same behaviour because the original depends on machinery that is out of scope (see epic-bricks Notes). 'assertion-changed' keeps the title but not an assertion, for the reason given. Source: cephlow apps/api-worker/src, read 2026-10-20.

tests.title: should reject if user is not authenticated
should reject if workspace context is missing
should reject if user is not member of workspace
should accept if user is member of workspace
should reject if workspace is suspended
should reject payments verify if the order does not belong to the user (H-5)
should verify roles with isAdminOrOwner helper
should handle DB errors in workspaceMiddleware
tests.why: cephlow asserts the raw database error text is returned to the caller (a mock throws 'DB Query Error'). The brick answers 500 with a generic message and the test asserts the SQL error text is NOT returned.

tests.title: should reject requireNotSuspended if workspace context is missing
should handle DB errors in requireNotSuspended
tests.why: same as above: a generic 500, never the database's own error text.

tests.title: should reject invalid amount
should reject amount less than minimum recharge
should create cashfree order successfully
should handle cashfree API failure gracefully
should reject missing order_id
should return already processed status if processed is true
should reject if cashfree status is not PAID
should reject if workspace for order does not exist
should successfully verify and credit workspace
should successfully charge standard rate for unpaid certificates
tests.why: the original drives /batches/:id/client-generate, which also needs a KV approvals cache, certificates and batches (out of scope); the rewrite drives the brick's own deduction.

tests.title: should reject generation if workspace balance is insufficient (C-2)
regeneration is free: no balance change and no ledger row for a zero cost
tests.from: routes/clientGenerate.test.ts, 'should charge 20% rate for already paid certificates requiring visual regeneration'
tests.why: the original is named for a 20% rate but asserts that regeneration is free (REGEN_RATE = 0); the rewrite carries what it asserts, under an accurate title.
